name: NY-08
label: Safe D

key_factors: Hakeem Jeffries is a well-funded incumbent with $5M on hand
Republican challenger has raised essentially nothing
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~96%
model.rationale: Jeffries holds a D+24 seat with overwhelming financial advantages and no meaningful challenger fundraising, while markets price his reelection near certain. Fundamentals point to a margin of roughly 30 points, comfortably in Safe D territory.
model.watch: Only a major scandal or redistricting shock could put this seat in play.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Brooklyn's NY-08 is one of the most Democratic-leaning House districts in the country, with a partisan lean of D+24. Hakeem Jeffries, the House Democratic leader, is seeking reelection with a massive financial edge: nearly $15 million raised and $5 million on hand, against a Republican challenger with no reported fundraising and no outside spending on either side.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give Jeffries roughly a 96% chance of winning. With the incumbent's profile, the district's lean, and the lopsided money situation, this race is rated Safe Democratic with little realistic prospect of a competitive contest.
